convention: One register for every team the pilot has flown, in any room. A row points at the unit; the unit holds the whole team, including the room it flew in. Seat identity (agent type, model) is in ../quarters/crew/MANIFEST-crew.json; a seat in a unit is name, reason, returns. Ids are counted across the whole register, assigned once, never renumbered.
